Subject: Privacy addendum and evidence request for upcoming RFP

Hi Kimberly,

We are moving Redwood Inference to the next stage of our RFP for the Ridgefield School District. Procurement has asked for the following to complete our vendor review and clear you for our Board packet:

- A signed privacy addendum (or DPA) that includes SCCs / EU transfer mechanism language (we may need this for contractors working with EU-student data later).
- SOC 2 Type II report (redacted is fine) and an executive summary.
- CAIQ/Consensus assessment mapping or a spreadsheet showing answers to CAIQ questions.
- Any standard DPIA scoping guidance you have for education deployments (we run a DPIA for services that process student data).
- Clarification on whether Redwood will accept our standard security addenda redlines and a timeline for review.

I attached the relevant RFP excerpt (Section H) to show where this sits in our procurement timeline. Our procurement deadline is 11/20; ideally we get these materials by 11/12 so we can present to the evaluation committee.

Thanks — can you confirm what you can provide and an ETA?

Best,
Elaine Turner
Director of Procurement
Ridgefield School District
Phone: (555) 214-8372

On Fri, Nov 5, 2026 at 10:03 AM Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Hi Elaine — thanks for the clear list and the excerpt. We can support the majority of items you listed; looping in our security and compliance leads to confirm a few specifics.

Hi all — quick clarifications and what I will attach:

1) SCCs / Data transfer mechanism: Redwood supports the EU Commission's standard contractual clauses for controller-processor transfers. For vendor procurement, we provide an addendum that embeds the SCCs (we prefer the Commission's 2021/2554 wording). If the district wants the 'clause as executed' we can include it in the DocuSign packet.

2) SOC 2: We will provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report (period 2025-06-01 to 2026-05-31) and a one-page executive summary. Attachment: SOC2-Report-2025-summary.pdf

3) CAIQ: Attached is our current CAIQ mapping workbook. It contains control references and notes for any tailored controls for on-prem/private deployments. Attachment: CAIQ-mapping-Redwood-2026.xlsx

4) DPIA: We don't perform a DPIA on behalf of customers but will provide a DPIA scoping worksheet and a data flow summary (processing categories, sub-processors, retention buckets, and technical controls) to help Ridgefield complete their DPIA. Attachment: DPIA-scope-template.docx. I recommend a 30-minute call to walk through special categories (student data) and clarify any local/state retention requirements.

5) HIPAA question: If any datasets include protected health information (e.g., school nurse records), we operate as a processor under our DPA and can agree to required obligations; we will need to review any specific state law constraints.

ETA: I will upload the SOC 2 executive summary, the CAIQ mapping, and the DPIA template to a secure drive by EOD today (11/05). I will also confirm the exact SCC text to include in the addendum; Kimberly, please start DocuSign after I send the final wording.

Thanks — Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra

Hi Elaine — great to e-meet. A few operational notes: 

- DocuSign: I will start a DocuSign envelope containing our standard Privacy Addendum + embedded SCC language after Rishi confirms the exact SCC variant. We typically allow 5 business days for legal review before countersignature; if Ridgefield needs faster, we can prioritize.

- Evidence delivery: For procurement, we will provide redacted SOC 2 and the CAIQ workbook via a secure, expiring Drive link. If you prefer an SFTP or an IP-restricted SharePoint upload, let me know and we will accommodate.

- Redlines: Please send any redline draft of your standard security addendum. We accept most operational redlines but will escalate anything that changes liability caps or indemnity outside our standard procurement playbook.

- DPIA support: We can schedule a 30-min DPIA scoping session. Proposed times: Wed 11/10 10:00–10:30 EST or Thu 11/11 09:30–10:00 EST. Which works best?

Procurement contact details for signature/PO routing would be helpful so we can line up the Docusign and PO templates.

Best,
